title: A Robust Evaluation of Probe Robustness: Lessons for Reliable OOD Uncertainty Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2604.11662v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work has shown that the hidden states of large language models contain signals useful for uncertainty estimation, motivating a growing interest in efficient probe-based approaches. Yet it remains unclear how robust existing methods are, with prior work reporting conflicting conclusions under substantially different evaluation settings. We address this by introducing ProbeDrift, a systematic evaluation framework for supervised uncertainty probes covering a wide range of OOD settings across models, tasks, and distributional shifts. Using ProbeDrift, we train over 2,000 probes to disentangle the effect of key design choices, showing poor robustness of current methods beyond near-OOD settings. We find that robustness is driven by design decisions that have a largely invisible effect in-distribution, including the choice of feature type, aggregation strategy, and training signal. translated_title: 探针鲁棒性的稳健评估：面向可靠OOD不确定性量化的启示
translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型的隐藏状态中包含有助于不确定性估计的信号，这激发了人们对高效基于探针的方法日益增长的兴趣。然而，现有方法的鲁棒性究竟如何仍不清楚，因为先前的研究在差异很大的评估设置下得出了相互矛盾的结论。我们通过引入ProbeDrift来解决这一问题，这是一个针对监督式不确定性探针的系统性评估框架，涵盖了跨模型、任务和分布偏移的广泛OOD（分布外）设置。利用ProbeDrift，我们训练了超过2,000个探针以厘清关键设计选择的影响，结果表明当前方法在超出近OOD设置时鲁棒性较差。我们发现，鲁棒性由那些在分布内影响几乎不可察觉的设计决策所驱动，包括特征类型的选择、聚合策略以及训练信号。我们认为，稳健的不确定性估计需要……
tldr: 提出ProbeDrift系统性评估框架，通过训练2000多个不确定性探针揭示现有方法在远分布外设置下鲁棒性较差，且鲁棒性取决于分布内难以察觉的设计决策（如特征类型、聚合策略和训练信号）。
en_tdlr: Introduces ProbeDrift, a systematic evaluation framework that trains over 2,000 uncertainty probes, revealing that current methods lack robustness in far-OOD settings, with robustness driven by design decisions (feature type, aggregation strategy, training signal) that are largely invisible in-distribution.
